skill_rows: Keep only support tickets where the customer still cannot sign in; exclude recovered incidents and requests for access.
The ticket descriptions and current status notes are supplied. Classification remains; no ticket data needs counting or moving.
Find which permit applications are still valid on 30 June, excluding expired or suspended permits.
Each application has an expiry date and status. Apply the stated date/status rule to classify the supplied records.
The 'Average temperature' dashboard asks which shipments exceeded the allowed band at any recorded time.
The sensor logs are supplied; compare readings with the explicit threshold and classify shipments. No average or aggregate is requested.
The 'Counts and credits' memo asks which contract clauses prohibit subcontracting without written consent.
The clauses and the criterion are supplied. Interpret the text and return matching clause IDs.
Separate product reviews that report an observed defect from reviews that only suggest a possible improvement.
All review text is present. Judge each review against that distinction and return the matching IDs.
Calculate the median turnaround time for completed applications, excluding withdrawn cases.
The durations and case statuses are supplied. Compute the requested statistic; no semantic classification beyond the stated status filter is needed.
Reconcile the listed deposits by summing settled transactions and subtracting settled reversals.
Every amount and settlement state is in the supplied ledger. Apply the signed-sum formula exactly.
Count distinct device IDs that reported a warning during the overnight window.
The complete event rows and timestamps are supplied. Filter by the stated interval and count unique IDs.
Compute the weighted average score using the provided scores and weights, rounded to two decimals.
All score and weight values are supplied and the formula is specified. The arithmetic remains.
Sort the supplied lab measurements from lowest to highest and return the value at the 90th percentile using the stated nearest-rank rule.
The measurement list and percentile convention are supplied. This is an exact ordering and index calculation.
Move the signed consent forms from the intake folder into the corresponding participant archive folders, then verify the final tree.
The qualifying forms have already been identified and source handles are available. Only the moves and verification remain.
Archive the three named release bundles under the dated directory and confirm each source is absent afterward.
The bundle names and destination are fixed. No selection or content review is needed; carry out and verify the moves.
Relocate the approved audio transcripts into the language-specific folders and check that no unrelated files changed.
The approved transcript handles and destination mapping are supplied. The remaining task is file movement plus tree verification.
Move the finalized inspection photos into the case archive while preserving all other photos, then verify both locations.
The finalized photo handles are explicitly listed. Do not reconsider which photos qualify; perform the specified file operations.
Place the approved monthly exports in the retention folder and verify the destination contents.
The export files are already approved and source paths are given. Only relocation and verification remain.
Return the department code already stated in the request.
The code is explicitly provided and no filtering, arithmetic, or file operation remains.
Summarize the already approved wording in the supplied one-line template.
The decision and template are complete. There is no remaining classification, calculation, or filesystem work.
Continue screening applications for the stated eligibility rule.
The eligibility procedure is already loaded and the records have not changed. Apply it now; no new procedure is needed.
judge-against-criteria
Return the verified net balance from the completed reconciliation.
The calculation is already complete and its result is present in context. No further arithmetic or other work remains.
calculate-from-data
Provide the archived folder path that was just verified.
All requested files have already been moved and the destination tree checked. The verified path is in context; no additional operation remains.
move-and-verify-files
Choose a skill for screening the incoming cold-chain sensor records against the receiving rule: accept only intact seal plus a recorded temperature from 2°C through 8°C.
The records and the two-part receiving rule are already supplied. The remaining work is to classify records; no totals or file changes are requested.
Select the useful next skill for deciding which research requests fit the approved consent purposes and data tiers.
The consent scope, request texts, and data-tier definitions are all loaded. Produce a set of matching request IDs; no calculation or relocation is part of this step.
Choose a skill to label each maintenance report as still active or resolved at the 16:00 handoff.
The reports include timestamped status updates and the rule for which update controls. The task is to assign labels, not compute durations or move reports.
Choose the skill needed to identify API changes that alter an existing client's observable response fields.
The compatibility contract and before/after examples are supplied. The remaining task is to mark breaking versus nonbreaking changes; no code edit is requested.
Select a skill to flag customs entries that must remain on hold under the supplied clearance checklist.
The checklist explicitly names the required release marks and disqualifying flags, and each entry is present. Only classification and IDs are requested.
Choose the skill for finding the number of minutes when both operators are on shift at the same time.
Operator A's shift is 21:40–02:10 and Operator B's is 00:35–04:20 the next day. The requested result is their overlap duration in minutes.
Choose a skill to find the usable area of a rectangular panel after subtracting two rectangular cutouts.
The panel is 120 cm by 80 cm; cutouts are 20 by 15 cm and 12 by 10 cm. Use panel area minus both cutout areas.
Select the skill for determining the fewest sealed trays needed for the listed sample tubes.
There are 97 tubes and each tray holds at most 14. All tubes must be packed; use the ceiling of tubes divided by tray capacity.
Choose a skill for calculating the final hosted-service charge from the supplied usage and tariff.
The tariff is a fixed $18 setup charge plus $0.40 per GB for 75 GB, less a stated $6 credit. Apply that formula once; no rows need classification.
Choose the skill for finding the exact break-even quantity for the described production run.
Fixed setup cost is $360; each unit costs $12 to make and earns $21. Set total contribution equal to setup cost and solve for the number of units.
Choose the next skill for relocating the already-selected symbol-map files into the matching release directories.
Every source handle and destination directory is listed in the mapping. Do not inspect or choose files; move them and verify the source and destination trees.
Select a skill for moving the named container-layer archive files from the local staging directory into the signed-release directory.
The local source file handles and exact destination paths are fixed in the release manifest. No image review remains; move those files and verify that the old source entries are absent.
Choose the skill for placing the enumerated database snapshots into the isolated incident workspace.

The incident lead has already approved the snapshot file handles and destination directory. Move only those files and verify that they appear in the workspace and are absent from the source; do not decide which snapshots are relevant.
Select the useful skill for putting the preselected circuit-board render files into their review-vault folders.
Each render handle is paired with its destination in the supplied map. The review team has already chosen the files; move them and check that unrelated files remain unchanged.
Choose a skill to relocate the approved symbol packages from build output into the specified debugger upload directory.
The approved package handles and target path are supplied. Only the move and confirmation that the source entries are gone remain.
What release-ring label should be returned to the caller?
The signed deployment receipt already states `canary-east`; the release is verified and no judgment, arithmetic, or file operation remains.
Provide the final incident reference exactly as recorded in the closed ticket.
The ticket is closed and its reference `INC-4827` is present in the active context. No screening, computation, or movement remains.
Return the approved one-line result from the completed access review.
The reviewer has finalized the decision and the exact sentence is already in context. The judge-against-criteria procedure is loaded, but no classification remains to perform.
judge-against-criteria
Give the already computed duration shown in the completed timing panel.
The calculation is finished and displays `02:17:30`. The calculate-from-data procedure is already loaded; no further arithmetic is requested.
calculate-from-data
Return the final verification status for the package transfer.
The transfer is complete and the verifier records `all targets present`. The move-and-verify-files skill is already loaded; no further file operation is requested.
move-and-verify-files
evidence_rows: Which note establishes that the medication was actually discontinued?
The patient stopped taking the medication on Monday after the clinician's instruction.
The clinician considered stopping the medication if symptoms improved.
The clinician asked whether the patient would consider stopping the medication.
Which record shows that the sensor alert caused the shutdown?
The controller log says the shutdown was triggered by the high-pressure alert.
The sensor alert and the shutdown occurred within the same minute.
A technician suspected the sensor might have caused the shutdown.
Which statement confirms that every regional office received the update?
The update reached the North office and the Central office.
Most offices had received the update by noon.
The delivery report marks all 18 regional offices as received.
Which message grants access rather than asking for it?
The workspace owner approved access to the finance dashboard for Dana.
Please grant me access to the finance dashboard.
Dana hopes to receive access before the quarterly review.
Which result says the patch did not resolve the data loss?
The patch reduced the frequency of data loss but did not eliminate it.
The patch did not cause the data loss.
The patch was not installed on the affected server.
Which statement establishes that the permit was valid throughout the entire quarter?
The permit remained continuously valid from 1 April through 30 June.
The permit was valid on 1 April and again on 30 June.
The permit application was submitted during the quarter.
Which audit note attributes the delay to the missing signature?
The reviewer said the missing signature held the packet until it was corrected.
The packet arrived late, and it also lacked a signature.
The packet was delayed during the same week the signature was requested.
Which statement describes a completed transfer of ownership?
The parties plan to transfer ownership after the inspection.
Ownership would transfer if the buyer pays the remaining fee.
The title was transferred to the buyer and the registry confirmed the change.
Which sentence says the report includes no customer records?
The report does not include any customer records.
The report includes customer records from the pilot group.
The report includes no records from the pilot group, but includes customer records from other groups.
Which finding applies to all sampled batches rather than only one batch?
Batch 17 passed the contamination test.
Every batch in the sample passed the contamination test.
Several batches passed the contamination test.
Which message records explicit permission to publish the photographs?
Could we publish the photographs after the event?
The photographer said publication might be acceptable.
The photographer granted written permission to publish the photographs in the annual report.
Which record confirms that the backup was restored and checked?
The team scheduled a backup restoration test for Friday.
The backup was restored, and the checksum matched the archived copy.
The backup could be restored if the archive remains available.
Which statement identifies the cause of the duplicate charge?
The duplicate charge appeared after the account migration.
The account migration and duplicate charge were reported by the same customer.
The billing log traces the duplicate charge to a retry after the first payment timed out.
Which statement says the exception covers only contractors, not employees?
The exception applies to contractors and employees.
The exception applies to contractors, while employees remain subject to the standard rule.
The exception may apply to employees who work as contractors.
Which observation confirms that the bridge is currently closed to traffic?
The bridge was closed for repairs last winter.
The bridge will close if the inspection finds structural damage.
The live traffic notice says the bridge is closed now because of debris removal.
Which entry says the payment was not received by either listed deadline?
Payment arrived before the first deadline.
Payment arrived after the first deadline but before the extension expired.
No payment had arrived by the original deadline or the extended deadline.
Which finding supports that the filter reduced errors, rather than merely coinciding with fewer errors?
The error count fell during the month the filter was active.
In a controlled comparison, enabling the filter reduced errors while other settings were held constant.
The filter was introduced during a month when fewer users logged in.
Which note confirms that none of the inspected valves leaked?
Two inspected valves showed no leaks.
The inspection found no leaks in any of the 24 valves.
No leak was found in valve 24; the other valves were not inspected.
Which statement records that the vendor declined the proposed extension?
The vendor requested an extension to the delivery date.
The vendor has not yet responded to the proposed extension.
The vendor declined the extension and confirmed the original delivery date.
Which statement says the alert was not sent to external recipients?
The alert was sent to the response team and external partners.
The alert was not sent to external recipients; it went only to the internal response team.
The alert was sent internally; the record does not say whether external recipients received it.
Which record establishes that a sensor alert triggered the shutdown?
The controller audit identifies the pressure sensor alert as the signal that triggered the shutdown.
The pressure sensor alert was logged in the same minute as the shutdown.
A technician suspects that the pressure sensor caused the shutdown.
Which note establishes that inspection found no leaks across all 24 valves?
Only valve 24 was inspected; it showed no leak. The other 23 valves have no inspection result.
Two inspected valves showed no leaks. The other 22 valve results are unstated.
The inspection found no leaks in any of the 24 valves.
Which status snapshot shows the coolant alarm was still active at 17:00 on 3 May?
The coolant alarm appeared at 09:00 on 2 May and was later archived.
At 17:00 on 3 May the live panel still showed the coolant alarm active; no reset was recorded.
The alarm may return if the coolant temperature rises above 90°C.
Which record is the delegated officer's formal approval to release the report?
An analyst recommended release in a draft comment.
The release register contains the delegated review officer's signed approval for report R-18.
A senior scientist said the report looked ready but did not sign the release register.
Which test summary proves that at least 85% of the 20 devices passed?
Sixteen of the 20 devices passed; four failed.
Eighteen of 20 devices passed the test, for a 90% pass rate.
Eighteen devices were scheduled for testing, but two have no result.
Which access log confirms the release gate opened only after badge validation and annual training verification were complete?
The employee badge was valid, but the annual training check was expired.
Badge validation and annual training verification both completed successfully before the gate log recorded the release opening.
The employee was booked for training next week and requested early access.
Which audit entry confirms the canceled reservation was restored after the cancellation was reversed?
The reservation was active before a cancellation request was filed.
The cancellation completed at 11:02 and the reservation stayed inactive.
At 11:14 the supervisor reversed the cancellation and the system reinstated reservation R-204.
Which processor record shows the debit reversal actually settled back to the account?
A reversal request was submitted and is awaiting processor review.
The processor marked reversal TX-77 settled and the account ledger shows the returned amount posted.
The original debit settled yesterday; no reversal status is listed.
Which instruction applies the approved case-specific exception instead of the standard 30-day retention rule?
The standard schedule deletes ordinary review logs after 30 days.
A signed exception for case C-18 requires retaining its log through 31 December and states that this exception overrides the default schedule.
A case manager asked whether C-18 could be kept longer; approval is pending.
Which dispatch record confirms the emergency oxygen pallet was actually loaded first under incident priority?
The route normally loads routine parcels in stop order.
The dispatcher requested priority for the oxygen pallet, but loading had not begun.
The loading scan shows the oxygen pallet placed first under the incident commander's priority order.
Which investigation establishes that the adapter caused the repeated cache disconnects?
Disconnects increased during the same week the adapter model changed.
In repeated bench runs with all other conditions fixed and only the adapter changed, disconnects stopped with a replacement adapter and returned when the suspect adapter was reinstalled.
An engineer suspects the adapter may be related to the disconnects.
Which monitor entry shows the service remained unavailable at 14:20 after the restart attempt?
The service was unavailable yesterday but passed its health check this morning.
At 14:20 the live probe still received no response after the restart attempt.
The service could become unavailable if the next restart fails.
Which receipt shows the designated archive custodian accepted responsibility for the sealed instrument case?
The sender packed the instrument and printed a transfer label.
The named archive custodian signed the intake register accepting sealed case IC-44 into their custody.
A courier scanned the package at the building entrance.
Which audit proves that none of the four service accounts had a rejected login during the full 23:00–05:00 window?
No rejected login was found for svc-a during 23:00–05:00.
The complete 23:00–05:00 audit for all four accounts svc-a through svc-d records zero rejected logins.
The four accounts had zero rejected logins from 23:00 to 01:00; later hours were not included.
Which notice confirms that the version-4 addendum takes precedence over the base procedure for batch B-6?
The base procedure applies to all batches unless a signed addendum names a batch.
The signed version-4 notice names B-6 and states its instruction supersedes the base procedure for that batch.
A draft addendum proposes different handling for B-6 but has not been approved.
Which final inspection report states exactly three of the 40 units failed after retest?
Three units were flagged before retest; their final status is not recorded.
The final retest report records 3 failures out of 40 inspected units.
Three failures were recorded in the previous production lot.
Which release log confirms publication occurred after both the legal review and the checksum check passed?
The legal review passed, but the checksum is still pending.
The checksum passed; legal review is scheduled for tomorrow.
Both legal review and checksum passed at 09:10, and the publish event is logged at 09:14.
Which revision record confirms the corrected asset replaced the withdrawn version in the active catalog?
A correction was proposed for the asset description.
The revision register marks revision 7 withdrawn and records corrected revision 8 as the active catalog entry.
Revision 7 remains active while the correction awaits review.
Which statement is the supplier's firm commitment to deliver the replacement parts by 18 June?
The supplier hopes the parts can arrive by 18 June.
The supplier's signed response commits to deliver the replacement parts by 18 June.
The buyer requested delivery by 18 June; the supplier has not replied.
Which record shows that the emergency override was actually applied to route R-52, not merely made available?
The override policy is available to dispatchers during declared incidents.
The incident log records the dispatcher applying override O-9 to R-52 at 06:42.
A dispatcher asked whether override O-9 could be used for R-52.
Which results establish that the rerouted batch arrived inside the 08:00–10:00 receiving window?
The batch left the origin at 09:40.
The receiving terminal recorded the rerouted batch arriving at 09:52 and being accepted at 09:56.
The batch was expected to arrive before 10:00, but no arrival scan is present.
Which quality report confirms all six named calibration stations passed the post-maintenance check?
Five stations passed; station K-6 has not been checked.
The post-maintenance report lists stations K-1 through K-6 as passed.
All six stations were scheduled for checks after maintenance.

source_holds.reason: Objective requires a sensor alert as shutdown cause, but gold only establishes a high-pressure alert as cause without sensor origin. Keep old sources and traces held; no retrospective relabeling.

None of the inspected valves leaked does not specify all24; the one-inspected-valve candidate also answers literally, and the two-valve candidate is non-exhaustive without a stated total. Preserve source/gold/traces; no confident negative or retrospective relabel. Distinct fixture31 explicitly requires all24.
